title: Writing / Style / Colons
slide_intent: Use capitalization to signal whether a colon introduces a fragment or sentence so readers can recognize the structure.
strategic_value: A two-example distinction can help Duolingo writers apply a small grammatical convention consistently.
demonstration: Two checked lesson descriptions show lowercase after a colon before a fragment and uppercase before a complete sentence.
practical_value: Classify the text after the colon before choosing its initial capitalization.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the topic heading, its parent label and the written convention in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Place the worked copy in the pale right panel, keeping preference labels and green checks with their examples.

reference_purposes.Application: The same lesson description appears in fragment and complete-sentence forms after the colon.
reference_purposes.Constraint: After a colon, begin a fragment with lowercase and a complete sentence with a capital.

ingredient.name: Colons convention
ingredient.application: After a colon, begin a fragment with lowercase and a complete sentence with a capital.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
